source: Enter the tournament
before: 输入锦标赛
after: 报名锦标赛

source: You're surrounded by buff, intense kiters with vibrant hair colors and oodles of protag energy. Yes, these are your people! You have to enter the tournament!
before: 周围是浓郁的风筝 有生动的发色 有面条的能量 是的,这是你的人民! 你必须进入比赛!
after: 周围全是肌肉发达、斗志高昂的风筝手，发色鲜艳，主角气场满得快溢出来。没错，这才是你的同类！必须参赛！

source: You're entering? That's awesome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't know you were a professional kite-flyer.
before: 你要进入? 这是真棒, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 我不知道你是职业风筝飞侠
after: 你要报名？太棒了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！都不知道你是职业风筝手。

source: Yet despite all logic, you are! You see, while Scott and Polly were busy being popular and having fun, you were busy STUDYING THE KITE!
before: 虽说有道理,但你还是有的! 你看,当时 斯科特 财务报告和审定财务报表 波莉 忙着受欢迎 玩得开心 你忙着玩玩的
after: 虽然没道理，可你就是！斯科特和波莉忙着受欢迎、享乐的时候，你在埋头苦练风筝之道！

source: Oh, THAT'S why you were unpopular? Wouldn't have been my first guess, but good for you, boo!
before: 哦,这就是为什么你不受欢迎? 不是我第一次猜想,但对你有好处,嘘!
after: 哦，你不受欢迎是因为这个？还真没想到，不过挺好，亲爱的！

source: Your friends sit in the audience to cheer you on, and you fly your kite up the bracket all the way to the final eight!
before: 你的朋友坐在观众席上为你欢呼, 你飞起你的风筝 整个括号 最终的8!
after: 朋友们坐进观众席给你加油，你一路高飞，杀进八强！

source: Hmm... you're my next competitor? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, is it? You fly your kite honorably; I can see you're well-trained.
before: 垛... 你是我的下一个竞争者?  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是吗? 你光荣地放风筝,我看你训练有素
after: 嗯……下个对手就是你？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，对吧？放风筝颇有君子之风，看得出训练有素。

source: But your reign of victory ends now.
before: 但你的胜利统治结束了
after: 不过，你的连胜，到此为止。

source: Gasp! That's Chiyo, THE LONESOME KITE! He's the mysterious, aloof protegé, and he'll stop at nothing to win and preserve his honor!
before: G! 那是千代,孤鸟! 他是神秘的, 孤独的蛋白质, 他会不惜一切代价赢得并维护他的荣誉!
after: 啊！是千代，孤独之筝！那位神秘冷傲的高徒，为赢比赛、捍卫荣誉，会不择手段！

source: Dude, how do you know all that?
before: 伙计,你怎么知道这些的?
after: 兄弟，这些你怎么知道的？

source: I've been reading the plot summary of this kite tournament on Munchyroll.
before: 我读过Munchyroll的风筝比赛的情节摘要
after: 在 Munchyroll 上，读了这场风筝大赛的剧情简介。

source: Your kite is well-constructed; graceful; she slips through the air like my sword through tender flesh.
before: 你的风筝很有造诣 有优雅的风筝 她从空中滑过 就像我用剑穿过柔软的肉
after: 你的风筝制作精良，姿态优雅，掠过空气，如我的剑切入柔嫩血肉。

source: But no matter how well-made your kite is, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it cannot fly without its tether!
before: 但是不管风筝的造型如何好,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,它不能飞 没有它的绳子!
after: 可 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，做得再好，没有线，它也飞不起来！

source: Chiyo jiggles his sword in its scabbard. You don't see it move -- but suddenly, you realize your kite line's been cut! Wow, so fast!
before: 千代在剑斋中一笑取出剑来. 你看不到它移动——但突然间,你意识到你的风筝线被切断了! 哇,这么快!
after: 千代轻轻动了动鞘中的剑。你没看见剑身移动，却突然发现，风筝线被斩断了！好快！

source: I hate to win like this, but more than that, I hate to lose. I'm sorry it has to be this way.
before: 我恨这样赢,但不止如此,我恨输。 对不起,一定是这样
after: 我不愿这样赢，可更不愿输。抱歉，只能如此。

source: That motherfucker! He's right, though; your kite can't fly without a string... or can it?
before: 那个混蛋! 他说得对,不过,你的风筝没有绳子是飞不起来的... 也可以吗?
after: 这混蛋！不过他说得对，没有线，风筝就飞不了……真的飞不了吗？

source: Give the kite an uplifting pep talk! Tell it that it's ready to fly by itself without your help.
before: 给风筝一个振奋人心的演讲! 告诉它已经准备好自己飞了 没有你的帮助。
after: 给风筝来段振奋人心的鼓励！告诉它，没有你的帮助，也已经能独自飞翔了。

source: You thought you needed the line to control the kite, but it was all a lie to stop you from reaching your potential. It's time to awaken. It's time to become... THE KITEMANCER!
before: 你以为你需要那条线来控制风筝 但这都是谎言 阻止你达到你的潜力 时已起起起. 是时候... 凯特曼克!
after: 以为必须靠线控风筝？不过是阻碍你潜力的谎言。该觉醒了，该成为……驭筝法师！

source: It's time for you to flourish, Kite! That line was just your training wheels. All this time, I told you that you needed it because I wanted to build your confidence.
before: 吉特,你该兴起了 那条线只是你的训练轮子 我一直都告诉你你需要它 因为我想建立你的信心
after: 风筝，展翅高飞的时候到了！线只是你的辅助轮。以前一直说你需要它，不过是想帮你树立信心。

source: But now, the time has come for you to know the truth... the power to fly was inside YOU all along!
before: 但现在,是时候让你知道真相了... 飞行的力量一直存在于你体内!
after: 如今，该知道真相了……飞翔的力量，一直就在你体内！

source: You throw your untethered kite valiantly into the air. The kite can't talk, so it can't express its feelings on this new development...
before: 你勇敢地把你的未系起的风筝扔入空中 风筝不能说话,所以不能表达对这个新发展的感觉. .
after: 你英勇地把断线风筝抛向空中。它不会说话，没法表达对新局面的感受……

source: So we'll be conveying the kite's ascent to greatness with song! Everybody, sing with me!
before: 将风筝的升华 与歌相伴而来! 大家一起唱吧,我们一起唱吧!
after: 那就用歌，表现它迈向伟大的历程吧！大家跟我唱！

source: LET'S GET DOWN TO BUSINESS / TO ACHIEVE THIS FLIGHT!
before: 让我们开始做生意 完成这场战役
after: 来把正事干／飞上那蓝天！

source: WITH THE STRENGTH INSIDE YOU / YOU WILL REACH NEW HEIGHTS!
before: 与更棒的 内你/你会 出现新的高!
after: 心中力量在／就能飞更远！

source: YOU'RE THE STRONGEST KITE I'VE EVER MET / YOU'VE GOT SPUNK, PASSION, AND SASS!
before: 你是我见过的最强的基特人 /你已经得到了弹出, 帕斯蒂安特和萨斯!
after: 你是我见过最强的筝／有热情、有胆量、还有劲！

source: AND SOMEHOW... WE WILL KICK... CHIYO'S ASS!
before: 和一些东西... 我们一定会踢出... 奇尧的屁股!
after: 总有办法……我们定要……把千代揍翻！

source: With the kite's newfound confidence and strength, and with the power of sing-alongs, your kite flies itself through the air and outperforms Chiyo in all respects!
before: 以风筝新出信心和力量,以出自"唱出"之能,使风筝自能从空中飞出,在各方面都超越了千代!
after: 风筝有了新信心、新力量，又有大合唱加持，自己在空中飞翔，各方面都碾压千代！

source: You throw your kite into the sky, where it buoys on the wind. Great! It's got height; now it just needs a pep talk!
before: 你把你的风筝扔到天空, 它在风上浮出水面。 不错! Great! 它有高度,现在它只需要说点什么!
after: 你把风筝扔上天，借风托住了。好，高度有了，只差一段鼓励！

source: The power to fly was inside it all along! The line that connected it was just its training wheels, which you used to boost its confidence.
before: 飞行的力量一直存在于其中! 连接它的线只是它的训练轮子, 你用来增强它的信心。
after: 飞翔的力量，一直在它体内！连接它的线，只是你用来提升它信心的辅助轮。

source: But now the time has come for the kite to fly solo, and achieve its dreams!
before: 但是现在风筝飞起独行的时机已经到来,实现了它的梦想!
after: 现在，是它独自高飞，追逐梦想的时候了！

source: Your kite can't talk, but it can feel, and you know that your pep talk is getting through to it... yes! It's flying!
before: 你的风筝不能说话,但感觉很舒服 而且你知道你的风筝说话已经... 没错! 飞了!
after: 风筝不会说话，可它有感受，你知道，鼓励传达到它心里了……对！它飞起来了！

source: ...Flying away from the tournament, over the horizon.
before: ...从比赛中飞出,在地平线上
after: ……飞出赛场，飞过地平线。

source: Ha! How pathetic. Your disloyal kite has abandoned you in your time of need!
before: 多么可悲,你还真是可怜 你的不忠风筝在需要的时候抛弃了您!
after: 哈，可悲。你最需要它时，不忠的风筝却抛弃了你！

source: Or maybe the kite just got caught in an updraft and was carried off in the wind? Because, you know, kites don't have autonomy?
before: 或者风筝刚刚被风吹倒了 被风吹倒了? 因为风筝没有自主权?
after: 也可能就是被上升气流卷走，顺风飘了？毕竟，风筝又没有自主意识？

source: You'll never know which. All you know is that without a kite, you're definitely disqualified. You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
before: 你永远也猜不到 你只知道没有风筝,你绝对是被取消资格的. 你输了2个HYPE和1个TORNAMENT。
after: 原因再也弄不清。只知道，没风筝，你肯定被取消资格。你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: Yes, of course! You close your eyes, honing the kite energy within you.
before: 当然了! 你闭上眼睛, 磨练出风筝的能量。
after: 没错，当然！你闭上双眼，凝聚体内的风筝之力。

source: You imagine the creation of the world: the Big Bang, the explosion of stars, the planetary bodies filling the empty vacuum of space...
before: 你想象世界的创造:大爆炸, 星空爆炸, 行星体填补了太空的空虚真空...
after: 你想象世界初生：宇宙大爆炸，恒星爆发，星球填满空荡的太空……

source: You see your planet being formed. It began as a sphere covered in fire. Then the mountains pushed up, and rocky Earth covered its crust.
before: 你看见你的星球正在形成 开始是一片被火所覆盖的球体 山地向上推来 岩石覆盖了地壳
after: 你看见自己的星球成形，最初是个火焰包裹的球体，山峦随后隆起，岩石土壤覆盖地壳。

source: Then water flooded the planet, the waves colliding with the newborn shores. And with water came plants, and with plants came air, the atmosphere you rely on to breathe.
before: 然后水淹没了地球 海水与新生海岸相撞 水来了,植物来了,空气来了, 空气的空气,你依赖的空气。
after: 接着，水淹没星球，浪拍着新生的海岸。有了水，就有植物；有了植物，就有空气，形成你赖以呼吸的大气。

source: And with air came wind, and on the wind came kites! The fifth element! Yeah, that's exactly how it worked!
before: 风吹来,风吹来风筝! 第五元素! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! 是啊,这正是它是如何工作的!
after: 有空气就有风，有风就有风筝！第五元素！对，绝对就是这么来的！

source: You must channel the wild, unbridled spirit of those first ancient kites. Their magic fills your core, exploding from within!
before: 你必须引导那些古老的风筝所形成的 野生的无所顾忌的精神 他们的魔法充斥着你的核心,从里面爆炸!
after: 你要引导最早那些远古风筝，狂野不羁的精神！魔法充满内心，由内向外爆发！

source: What is this madness? How are you controlling your kite with random martial arts poses?!
before: 这是什么疯狂? 如何控制风筝 随机武术姿势?
after: 什么疯魔之术？随便摆几个武术姿势，怎么就控制住风筝了？！

source: Because %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% just became the legendary Kitemancer, bro! Now %HESHE% can control all the kites!
before: 因为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 刚刚成为传奇的克特曼斯,兄弟! 现在 %HESHE% 能够控制风筝!
after: 因为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 刚成为传说中的驭筝法师啊，兄弟！现在 %HESHE% 能控制所有风筝！

source: Wait, ALL the kites? This just got way easier. You take control of Chiyo's kite and crash it hard into the ground.
before: 等等,风筝都响了? 事情就变简单了 你控制了千代的风筝,把它撞入地里去.
after: 等等，所有？这下简单了。你控制千代的风筝，狠狠撞向地面。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
before: 别走,别走,别走

source: Yes, of course! You close your eyes, honing the kite energy within you.
before: 当然了! 你闭上眼睛, 磨练出风筝的能量。
after: 没错，当然！你闭上双眼，凝聚体内的风筝之力。

before: 你想象世界的创造:大爆炸, 星空爆炸, 行星体填补了太空的空虚真空...
after: 你想象世界初生：宇宙大爆炸，恒星爆发，星球填满空荡的太空……

before: 你看见你的星球正在形成 开始是一个完全被火所覆盖的球体。 山地向上推来 岩石覆盖了地壳
after: 你看见自己的星球成形，最初是个完全被火焰包裹的球体，山峦随后隆起，岩石土壤覆盖地壳。

source: Then water flooded the planet, the waves colliding with the still-young shores. And with water came plants, and with plants came air, the atmosphere you rely on to breathe.
before: 水淹没了地球 海水与年轻海岸相撞 水来了,植物来了,空气来了, 空气的空气,你依赖的空气。
after: 接着，水淹没星球，浪拍着尚且年轻的海岸。有了水，就有植物；有了植物，就有空气，形成你赖以呼吸的大气。

before: 风吹来,风吹来风筝! 第五元素! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! 是啊,这是完全如何 它的工作!
after: 有空气就有风，有风就有风筝！第五元素！对，百分之百就是这么回事！

before: 你必须引导那些古老的风筝所形成的 野生的无所顾忌的精神 他们的魔法充斥着你的核心,从里面爆炸!
after: 你要引导最早那些远古风筝，狂野不羁的精神！魔法充满内心，由内向外爆发！

source: Polly, what is %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doing?
before: 波莉,这是什么 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 做什麽?
after: 波莉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 在干什么？

source: Random martial arts poses and incoherent yelling, it looks like.
before: 随机出拳的姿势和不协调的叫声,看起来像.
after: 看着像乱摆武术姿势，再加上胡乱大叫。

source: Oh... do you think %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% noticed %HISHER% kite flew away on an updraft?
before: 哦... 你觉得 %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% 已注意到 %HISHER% 风筝飞走的升空?
after: 哦……你觉得 %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% 发现 %HISHER% 风筝被上升气流卷走了吗？

source: Given that %HESHE% just dropped dramatically to %HISHER% knees and shouted "NOOO" for a minute straight, I'ma go with yes.
before: 既然这样 %HESHE% 刚刚急剧下降到 %HISHER% 膝盖和高喊"NOOO" 一分钟直,我要去是的。
after: 看 %HESHE% 刚跪得那么夸张，%HISHER% 双膝一着地，就连喊了一分钟“不——”，我猜发现了。

source: HOW COULD YOUR NONSENSICAL PLAN HAVE GONE SO AWRY?! You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
before: 你没有计划会这么痛苦吗? 你输了2个HYPE和1个TORNAMENT。
after: 这毫无道理的计划，怎么会出这么大的岔子？！你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: I can't believe it... you've defeated me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and brought shame upon my name.
before: 我简直不敢相信... 你打败了我 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%并给我的名字带来耻辱。
after: 不敢相信……你赢了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，令我名誉扫地。

source: It seemed that while my blade could slash your kite string, there was a stronger string all along that connected both our souls...
before: 似乎我的刀能割去你的风筝弦 却一直有根更强的弦 连接着我们的灵魂...
after: 我的刀虽能斩断你的筝线，可原来，你我灵魂之间，始终有条更坚韧的线……

source: Well done.
before: 干得不错
after: 干得漂亮。

source: Fuck yeah! You ascend to the Final Four. With your kite's new power, your victory should be assured!
before: 他妈的是的! 你升入最后四强 凭你风筝的新力量,你胜利应该保证!
after: 他妈的，爽！晋级四强！有风筝的新力量，胜利应该稳了！

source: YOUR DEFEAT IS ASSURED! For it is I, your next opponent: Sarth of the Cobra Kite!
before: DE絋) 因为这是我,你的下个对手:眼镜蛇Kite的Sarth!
after: 稳输才对！因为下个对手是我，眼镜蛇风筝的萨尔斯！

source: You already defeated Chiyo, my greatest rival... WHICH IS WHAT I WAS SUPPOSED TO DO! What the hell, bro?!
before: 你已经打败了千代,我最大的对手... 我该做的就是! 搞什么鬼,兄弟? ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! !
after: 你已经击败我最大的宿敌千代……可那本该由我来干！搞什么，兄弟？！

source: For failing to uphold the co-bro code of not getting in the middle of monogamous sworn rivalries, I'm afraid I need to take you out of the competition...
before: 由于没有坚持不陷入一夫一妻制的誓言竞争的同父异母守则,我恐怕需要把你从竞争中取出......
after: “蛇兄弟守则”说了，专属宿敌关系，不许第三者插足。你没遵守，只能把你淘汰了……

source: Sarth swerves his kite to crash into yours! You manage to dodge his attack; he's only able to leave a tiny scratch on your kite's surface.
before: 萨尔斯转过风筝撞到你的了! 你躲过了他的攻击 他只能给你的风筝表面留下一丝小伤痕
after: 萨尔斯操纵风筝猛撞过来！你及时躲开，只让风筝表面擦出一道小伤。

source: Don't look so smug. I didn't need to crush you with force; I only needed to apply the secret Cobra Kite technique...
before: 别这么自以为是 我不需要用武力压倒你 我只需要运用秘密的眼镜蛇克提技术...
after: 别得意，用不着武力碾压你。我只需施展，眼镜蛇风筝的秘密招数……

source: I just grazed your kite with my venomous Kite Fangs! Your kite will never survive to see the end of the round! HAHAHA!
before: 我刚刚用我的毒气取出克特方斯来擦了你的风筝! 你的风筝永远无法活下来 来看轮子的结束! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈!
after: 刚才擦过你的，是我带毒的风筝獠牙！你的风筝，活不到这轮比赛结束！哈哈哈！

source: Wait, Sarth poisoned your kite?! THAT'S SOMETHING HE CAN DO?!?
before: 等等,萨尔斯毒死你的风筝了? 这是他能做的吗?
after: 等等，萨尔斯给你的风筝下毒？！他还能干这个？！

source: You need to save your kite before it's too late!
before: 趁现在还来得及,你一定要省下风筝!
after: 得赶在太迟之前，救下风筝！

source: Focus! This technique is just psychological warfare to make you lose your cool. Just remember kites don't have cardiovascular systems and thus they can't really get poisoned.
before: 专心点! 这是一种心理战, 让你失去冷静。 记住风筝没有心血管系统 所以它们不会真的被下毒
after: 冷静！那招不过是心理战，让你乱阵脚。风筝又没心血管系统，不可能中毒。

source: So he poisoned your kite? Then fight fire with fire: POUR GASOLINE ON HIS KITE AND SET IT ON FIRE!
before: 所以他给你的风筝下毒了? 然后用火来打: 将GASOLINE 放在他的基特上,然后把它放在火上!
after: 给你风筝下毒？那就以火攻毒：给他的风筝浇汽油，点了它！

source: You stay calm and keep flying your kite like normal. As expected, nothing bad happens to it.
before: 你冷静点,继续正常地放风筝 如所料,无所不坏.
after: 你不慌不忙，照常放风筝。果然，什么事也没有。

source: What's going on? Why isn't your kite succumbing to my deadly venom?!
before: 发生了什么事? 你的风筝怎么不屈服于我致命的毒液?
after: 怎么回事？你的风筝，为什么没被我的致命毒液毒倒？！

source: Because kites don't have cardiovascular systems or blood or anything, dummy. Therefore, venom won't affect it.
before: 因为风筝没有心血管系统 血液什么的,傻瓜。 因此,毒液不会影响它。
after: 因为风筝没有心血管系统，没血什么的，笨蛋。毒液当然没用。

source: WHAT?! Is that true?!
before: 什麽? 是真的吗?
after: 什么？！真的？！

source: ...Yes.
before: 对

source: Holy shit. I can't believe it. I went all in on this venom technique for nothing!
before: 妈的。 岂能相取. 我白费了这个毒液技术
after: 卧槽，不敢信。我钻研这套毒液招数，全白干了！

source: Fine, you win this round. But I'll be back next year, with non-venomous kiting techniques to defeat you in a head-to-head "cobrawl"!
before: 好吧,你赢了这轮。 但我明年会回来,用无毒打风技巧打倒你,在"相扑"中打倒你!
after: 行，这轮算你赢。明年我会带着无毒的放风筝招数回来，跟你正面对决，来场“蛇式肉搏”！

source: Whatever! You just care about winning the tournament today!
before: 随便啦! 你只要关心今天的比赛就赢了!
after: 管他呢！你只想赢下今天的比赛！

source: Yeah, you can resist this psychological warfare by fighting back with total apathy! You'll keep flying your kite no matter what!
before: 对抗心理战,你才能抵抗这种心理战,用完全冷漠的心理来反击! 你无论怎样都会继续放风筝的!
after: 对，彻底无动于衷，就能破解心理战！不管怎样，继续放风筝！

source: Whoa, you're not even going to try and give your kite antivenom or something? Don't you care about your kite?
before: 哇,你甚至不 尝试给你的风筝抗毒药什么的? 你不在乎你的风筝吗?
after: 哇，连抗毒药什么的，都不给它试试？不在乎自己的风筝吗？

source: I can't believe that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would heartlessly let %HISHER% kite die of anaphylactic shock!
before: 我简直不敢相信 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 将无情地让 %HISHER% 风筝死于无血脉震荡!
after: 不敢相信，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 居然能狠心让 %HISHER% 风筝，死于过敏性休克！

source: I came to this kite tournament to have a fun afternoon and shatter the spirits of my rivals, not watch negligent kite slaughter!
before: 我来到这风筝锦标赛 玩得开心的下午 打破了对手的魂魄 不是看疏忽的风筝屠宰!
after: 我是来享受下午的比赛，粉碎对手意志的，不是来看你疏忽照料、杀害风筝的！

source: I guess today we've learned %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would let ALL %HISHER% loved ones die from poison just to win this tournament.
before: 我想今天我们已经学会了 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 会让所有人 %HISHER% 为了赢得这场比赛 爱的人被毒死
after: 看来懂了，为赢这场比赛，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 能眼看着所有 %HISHER% 亲人被毒死。

source: %HESHE% may win the kite tournament... but %HESHE% %VERB_HAS_HAVE% lost the friendship tournament...
before: %HESHE% 可能会赢得风筝锦标赛... 不过 %HESHE%  %VERB_HAS_HAVE% 失去了友谊赛...
after: %HESHE% 或许赢了风筝大赛……可 %HESHE% %VERB_HAS_HAVE% 输了友谊大赛……

source: Noooo, now everyone's mad at you! You decide to forfeit so you can take your kite to the hospital.
before: 不,现在大家都生你的气了! 你决定没收,这样你就可以把你的风筝送到医院去。
after: 不——这下所有人都生你气了！你决定弃权，送风筝去医院。

source: You beg the doctor to save your kite from death by poison. He says, "Kites can't be poisoned. Why and how would that ever happen? Stop wasting my time."
before: 你乞求医生 让你的风筝免于被毒药所害 他说:"凯特斯不能被下毒. 为什么和如何会发生这种情况? 别再浪费我的时间了"
after: 你求医生，救救快被毒死的风筝。他说：“风筝中不了毒。怎么可能，又为什么会这样？别浪费我的时间。”

source: HAHAHA! You fell for my "cobrainy" ruse! The true psychological warfare at work here was the poisonous influence of peer pressure!
before: 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 你爱上了我的"胆小鬼"花招! 真正的心理战在这里工作 是同龄人的压力的毒害!
after: 哈哈哈，被我的“蛇机妙算”骗到了吧！真正起作用的心理战，是同伴压力的毒害！

source: Ugh, did Sarth seriously come to the hospital just to gloat? What a "cobrastard"! You lose -2 MIND and -1 TOURNAMENT.
before: 萨尔斯真的来医院只是为了幸灾乐祸吗? 多么"眼镜怪"! 你失去了2个心智和1个心智
after: 唉，萨尔斯还专程跑医院炫耀？真是个“蛇混蛋”！你失去了 -2 头脑和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: Good thing you thought ahead and brought a can of lighter fluid. You chuck it at Sarth's kite and chase it with a lit match.
before: 幸好你提前想到了 带了一罐更轻的液体 你把它丢在萨斯的风筝上 用点燃的火柴来追赶它
after: 还好有先见之明，带了一罐打火机油。你朝萨尔斯的风筝扔过去，紧跟着扔了根点着的火柴。

source: NOOOOOOOOO! You deduced my kite's greatest weakness! Poison-type kites are weak to fire!
before: 诺克! 你推论出我风筝最大的弱点了! 毒型风筝火力很弱!
after: 不——！竟然识破了我风筝最大的弱点！毒属性风筝，被火克制！

source: Uhh, I'm pretty sure ALL kites are weak to fire, poison or not. 'Cause they're, y'know, flammable?
before: 呃,我敢肯定,所有的风筝都无力 火,毒药与否。 因为他们是,你知道,易燃?
after: 呃，风筝不管带不带毒，应该都怕火吧？毕竟它们……易燃？

source: Actually, the more correct word is "inflammable." The word "flammable" gained popularity because "inflammable" sounds like its opposite, but--
before: 实际上,更正确的词是"可燃","可燃"一词因为"可燃"听起来相反而获得了人们的欢迎,但是——
after: 其实，更准确是 inflammable，也就是“易燃”。后来大家更爱用 flammable，是因为 inflammable 听着像反义词，不过——

source: Who asked you, Chiyo?! You already lost the tournament; you don't need to butt into conversations to be a vocab-snob and feel smart!
before: 谁问你的,千代? 你输了比赛,你不需要在谈话中 成为巫师,觉得聪明!
after: 千代，谁问你了？！已经出局，就别插嘴卖弄词汇，装聪明了！

source: You defeated me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... my "cobrand" has been forever tainted. Please, plunge this poisonous fang into my chest and kill me with honor.
before: 你打败了我 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 我的"花花公子"被永远玷污了 请把这个毒牙塞入我的胸口 光荣地杀了我
after: 你赢了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……我的“蛇家招牌”，永远蒙羞。请将这颗毒牙刺入我胸，让我光荣死去。

source: Uh... no? You're not gonna murder Sarth over a kite tournament, right?
before: 额... 对不对? 你不会为了风筝比赛而谋杀萨斯吧?
after: 呃……算了吧？总不会为了风筝比赛，就把萨尔斯杀了，对吧？

source: Good thing you thought ahead and brought a can of lighter fluid. You're about to chuck it at Sarth's kite...
before: 幸好你提前想到了 带了一罐更轻的液体 你准备把它丢在萨斯的风筝上...
after: 还好有先见之明，带了一罐打火机油。你正准备朝萨尔斯的风筝扔……

source: "HEY!" shouts one of the tournament organizers. "What are you doing with that lighter fluid?!"
before: "HEY!"高喊一个赛事组织者. "你拿这更轻的液体干什么?"
after: 一个赛事组织者大喊：“嘿！你拿打火机油干什么？！”

source: Uh... nothing?
before: 额... 没什么?
after: 呃……没什么？

source: Were you about to pour lighter fluid all over my kite and set it on fire? What a needlessly "cobrutal" thing to do!
before: 你准备把更轻的液体倒在我的风筝上放火吗? 做"同志"真是无谓!
after: 刚想往我风筝上倒打火机油，再放火？何必这样“蛇分残忍”！

source: Yeah, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that's bad sportsmanship! You can't solve all your problems by setting them on fire.
before: 对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%这太不运动了! 你不能用放火解决所有问题.
after: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这可没体育精神！哪能所有问题，都靠点火解决。

source: But Damien does it all the time, and everybody loves him! He's the most popular character in this franchise!
before: 不过 达米恩 总是这样 大家都爱他 他是这个特许经营中最受欢迎的人物!
after: 可德魔一直这么干，大家还爱他！他是这系列里，最受欢迎的角色！

source: So? Jeez, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, get your own thing for once.
before: 那又怎样? 天啊 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%得到你自己的东西一次。
after: 所以呢？天啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能不能有一次，找点自己的特色。

source: The tournament organizer calls the police.
before: 锦标赛组织者报警.
after: 赛事组织者报了警。

source: You know, we've been looking for a criminal who commits frequent acts of arson. This kid kinda fits the bill.
before: 我们一直在寻找一个经常纵火的罪犯 这孩子挺适合的
after: 一直在找那个经常纵火的犯人。这孩子，看着挺符合。

source: Yeah, the infamous "Spicy Red Adult", as he goes by.
before: 是啊,臭名昭著的"辣红大人",他走。
after: 对，臭名昭著的“火辣红大人”，他自称的。

source: No, it's not me! You're looking for Damien! Arrest HIM!
before: 不,不是我! 不是我,我错了! 你在找谁? 达米恩! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他! 逮捕他!
after: 不，不是我！你们找的是德魔！抓他！

source: Nevertheless, they arrest YOU, and you definitely can't win this kite tournament from jail. You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
before: 尽管如此,他们还是逮捕你, 你绝对不能赢得这场风筝比赛 从监狱。 你输了2个HYPE和1个TORNAMENT。
after: 可警察还是把你抓了。关进牢里，肯定赢不了风筝赛。你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: And so, after two fierce fights, you make it to the final round of the tournament, where the best of the best compete and character arcs are dramatically completed.
before: 因此,经过两次激烈的争斗,你终于成功打入了联赛的最后一回合,其中最好的竞争对手和人物弧的成绩都显著地完成.
after: 两场激战后，你闯进决赛。最强的对手，将在这里交锋，角色的成长故事，也将在这里壮烈收尾。

source: The stakes have never been higher!
before: 赌注从未高过!
after: 从没这么紧张过！

source: YOU'RE my final opponent? Seriously? I thought it'd at least be Sarth or Chiyo, not some total amateur.
before: 你是我最后的对手? 真的吗? 我以为至少是萨斯或千代 而不是一些业余爱好者
after: 决赛对手是你？认真？以为起码是萨尔斯或者千代，怎么是个纯菜鸟。

source: Whatever, kicking your ass will be a total breeze! I'm F.J., COMMANDER OF WIND!
before: 不管怎么样,踢你的屁股会是一个完全的微风! 我是F. J. , 温德指挥员!
after: 算了，赢你不过一阵风。我是 F.J.，风之统帅！

source: The fuck? If F.J. can control the wind, and this is a kite tournament, isn't that basically cheating?
before: 他妈什么? 若为法相. 风能控制,这是风筝比赛,是不是基本上作弊?
after: 什么鬼？F.J. 能控风，这又是风筝比赛，不就等于作弊？

source: Eh, not really; in an anime-style sports tournament, special powers and ultimate moves are all fair game.
before: 并不是,在动漫式的运动锦标赛中, 特殊的力量和最终的动作都是公平的比赛。
after: 也不算。动漫式体育大赛，超能力和必杀技，都是规则内操作。

source: But F.J. has a reputation for sabotaging kites, bribing the judges, and using explosives to rig the competition... which are all definitely cheating.
before: 但F. J. .. 拥有破坏风筝,贿赂法官,利用炸药来操纵竞争的名声. . 绝对是作弊
after: 可 F.J. 出了名，会破坏风筝、贿赂评委，还拿炸药操纵比赛……这些绝对算作弊。

source: Don't look now, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but it looks like SOMEBODY swapped your kite fabric for porcelain! Good luck winning now, rookie!
before: 不要看现在, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%但好像有人把你的风筝织物换了瓷器! 祝你好运,新手!

source: Oh no, porcelain is the worst kite material! It's so heavy and breakable!
before: 哦,不,瓷器是最烂的风筝材料! 如此重而可破也!
after: 哦不，最不适合做风筝的，就是瓷！又重又脆！

source: Tch, typical F.J. And he wonders why his unofficial kiter nickname is "That Fucking Jerk".
before: Tch,典型的F.J. ch. 他想知道为什么他的非官方风筝外号是"那个混蛋".
after: 嘁，典型的 F.J.。还纳闷，别人为什么私下叫他“那个该死的混蛋”。

source: What a "cobrutal" twist! Surely there's no way %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% can come out of this one on top!
before: 简直是一团糟! 肯定没有办法 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 上面的这个可以出来!
after: 多么“蛇分残忍”的转折！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这下绝不可能翻盘了！

source: Maybe not, but you've come this far and aren't backing down now! You've still got one more trick up your sleeve...
before: 也许不是,但你已经走这么远了,现在没有退缩了! 你还有一件小事要处理...
after: 也许，可都到这一步，绝不退缩！你还藏着最后一招……

source: Your kite won't survive once you throw it to the skies, so you must aim to kill: throw your porcelain kite DIRECTLY into F.J.'s kite. A TRUE KAMIKAZE ATTACK!
before: 你扔到天空后风筝就活不下去 所以必须瞄准杀杀: 直接把你的瓷风筝扔入F. J. 的风筝中去. 真正的加美子袭击!
after: 瓷风筝一抛上天，肯定保不住，干脆搏命：直接砸向 F.J. 的风筝。真正的神风特攻！

source: You still have a few minutes to go full engineer and bring your kite to its next evolutionary state: a kickass drone.
before: 你还有几分钟时间去完成一个完整的工程师 把你的风筝带到下一个进化状态: 一个令人兴奋的无人机。
after: 还有几分钟，化身工程师，让风筝进化到下个阶段：酷炫无人机。

before: 你摆平了你的视线, 紧张了你的肌肉, 并扔出你的瓷风筝 与一发千金的快活!

before: 多么可悲,你还真是可怜 你还想干什么? 你的风筝显然不会飞了!

after: 你得意地说：“知道。可我不是要它飞，是要它杀出重围。”

source: CRASH!
before: 疯狂!
after: 轰！

source: NANI?!
before: 纳尼!
after: 纳尼？！

source: HOLY SHIT!
before: 神圣的地狱!
after: 卧槽！

source: WHOA!
before: 呜哇!

before: 你们俩的风筝都倒下——但是在一拍而成的瞬间,你的风筝在F.J.的几秒钟后就打倒了地,让你成为技术取胜者!
after: 两只风筝双双坠落，可在必须回看画面才能分胜负的关键时刻，你的风筝晚了 F.J. 几秒落地。按规则，你赢了！

source: You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Finally, our years of training have come to fruition. I always knew you had it in you.
before: 你做到了,你赢了 You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 最后,我们多年的训练已取得成果。 我一直知道你有这本事

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! YOU DID IT! You defeated F.J., effectively avenging the murder of your father!
before: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你做到了! 你赢了! You did it! 你打败了F. J. ,有效地报复了你父亲的被谋杀!

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, seeing you fight with such passion and finesse has made me realize that my feelings for you go beyond friendship...
before: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%看到你如此热情和技巧的战斗 让我意识到 我对你的感情超越了友谊
after: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看你带着如此热情与技巧战斗，才明白，我对你的感情，早已超越友谊……

source: Shoo, shoo! Go away, generic anime characters! Stop building random lore around %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
before: 嘘,嘘! 走开,普通的动画人物! 别再乱搞了 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
after: 去去去！走开，量产动漫角色！别乱给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 编背景故事。

source: Hey, fam, let's leave with the spoils of the battle before %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% gets sucked into a different piece of fiction.
before: 嘿,Fam,让我们离开 战利品的战利品之前,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 被吸进不同的小说。
after: 各位，趁 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 还没被吸进另一部作品，赶紧带着战利品走吧。

source: As you drive away, you see the face of your late father in the clouds, looking at you with approval.
before: 出走一回,见先父相貌入云中取相去来相好相与赞.
after: 开车离开时，你看见已故父亲的面孔，浮现在云间，赞许地望着你。

source: What are you doing? No, stop! That's not your real father, just a generic anime dad. Ignore that cloud, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Enough anime vibes for today!
before: 你在干吗? 不,停下来! 那不是你真正的父亲 只是个普通的动画爸爸 别管那个云 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 今天的气息够多了!
after: 干什么？不，停！那不是你真爸爸，只是个量产动漫爹。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别看那朵云！今天的动漫味，已经够了！

source: Eh, anyway: you leave with the +2 MONEY and +1 HYPE from the kite tournament. What a character arc!
before: 带好风筝锦标赛的+2分钱和+1分钱 多么个角色的弧!
after: 嗯，总之，风筝大赛带给你 +2 金钱和 +1 热度，满载而归。多么完整的成长故事！

source: You set your sights, tense all your muscles, and throw your porcelain kite with THE STRENGTH OF A THOUSAND KITES!
before: 你摆平了你的视线, 紧张了你的肌肉, 并扔出你的瓷风筝 与一发千金的快活!
after: 你瞄准目标，绷紧全身肌肉，使出千筝之力，把瓷风筝抛了出去！

source: Sadly, you only manage to throw it about a foot in the air.
before: 可惜你只把它扔到空中一英尺
after: 可惜，只往上扔了一英尺。

source: HAHAHA! How pathetic! You lack the STAMINA necessary to give your porcelain kite any momentum at all!
before: 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 真可悲! 简直是太可悲了! 你缺乏必要的STAMINA 给您的瓷风筝任何动力!
after: 哈哈哈，可悲！体力根本不够，还想让瓷风筝飞起来？！

source: But... but I had the strength of a thousand kites...!
before: 不过... 但我有一千只风筝的力量...
after: 可……我明明有千筝之力……！

source: So? Why would you try to harness "the strength of a thousand kites" anyway? Kites are designed to be lightweight and aerodynamic, dummy, not strong.
before: 怎么样? 你为什么试着利用"千筝之力"呢? 克特斯被设计为轻量级和空气动力,假人,不强.
after: 所以呢？干吗要借“千筝之力”？风筝讲究轻巧、顺风，又不讲力气，笨蛋。

source: Oof, should've thought of that. You also shouldn't have thrown your kite straight up in the air, because when it comes crashing down, it hits you square in the head.
before: 哦,应该已经想到了。 你不应该把你的风筝直接扔到空中 因为当它坠入地底时 它会打入你的脑袋
after: 唉，早该想到了。而且不该笔直往头顶扔，因为风筝掉下来，正好砸中你的脑袋。

source: You end up in the hospital to treat your concussion. Worse, you lose -2 STAMINA and -1 TOURNAMENT.
before: 你最后会去医院治疗脑震荡 更糟的是,你输了2个斯塔米纳和1个图尔纳特
after: 你进医院治疗脑震荡。更糟的是，失去了 -2 体力和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: In the precious minutes before the final round starts, you bust ass in a technology-upgrade montage to save your kite.
before: 在最后一轮比赛开始前的珍贵几分钟里 你为了救风筝 被技术升级的蒙太奇打得屁滚尿流
after: 决赛前宝贵的几分钟，你拼命赶工，上演技术升级蒙太奇，挽救风筝。

source: Tch! What a sad last-ditch effort. Why are you even trying to do? That porcelain disaster will never fly!
before: 嘘! 最后一下多伤心啊 你为何要这么做? 瓷器灾难永远不会飞起!
after: 嘁，垂死挣扎。到底想干什么？那块瓷器灾难，根本飞不起来！

source: Oh, WON'T IT?!
before: 哦,不是吗?
after: 哦，是吗？！

source: You whip out your remote control and pilot your kite-drone into the air!
before: 你抽出遥控器, 驾驶你的风筝德龙到空中去!
after: 你掏出遥控器，让风筝无人机飞上天！

source: NANI?!
before: 纳尼!
after: 纳尼？！

source: HOLY SHIT!
before: 神圣的地狱!
after: 卧槽！

source: WHOA!
before: 呜哇!
after: 哇！

source: Ha... haha... HAHAHAHA! What a weak twist! This isn't over! My kite ALSO has a final form!
before: 那个... 哦... 万岁! 扭得真弱! 扭得真紧! 还没完呢! 我的风筝还有最后的形状!
after: 哈……哈哈……哈哈哈！这点反转？还没完！我的风筝，也有最终形态！

source: F.J. does some dramatic poses and screams at the top of his lungs. In a burst of blinding light, his regular kite transforms into...
before: 费·J. 做一些戏剧性的姿势 和尖叫在他的肺顶端。 在一阵盲光中 他的风筝会变成...
after: F.J. 夸张地摆姿势，扯着嗓子嘶吼。刺目光芒爆发，普通风筝化作……

source: A bigger, stronger, weirder-looking kite?
before: 更大更强更怪的风筝?
after: 一只更大、更强、样子更奇怪的风筝？

source: BEHOLD! The Forbidden Kite Jutsu, FORM NINE! The most complex and undefeatable form in all of kiting!
before: 贝霍德! 紫禁克特·朱图克,FORM NINE! 风筝最复杂最难打!
after: 看好了！风筝禁术，第九式！风筝之道中，最复杂、最不可战胜的形态！

source: Meh, it's still a kite made of fabric no matter how many poses F.J. does. You shoot it down with your drone easily.
before: 不论F. J. 有多少人 都还是用布料做的风筝 已经 你用无人机轻易地击落它
after: 嘁，姿势摆得再多，也还是布做的风筝。你的无人机，轻松把它打了下来。

source: NOOOOOOOOOO!
before: 诺克卢斯!

source: You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Finally our years of training have come to fruition. I always knew you had it in you.

after: 做到了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。多年训练，终于结出果实。早就知道，你能行。

source: I am... proud of you.
after: 我……为你骄傲。

before: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你做到了! 你赢了! You did it! 你打败了F. J. ,有效地报复了你父亲的被谋杀!

before: 真是个曲折!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 一直都是真正的锦标赛恶棍!

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, your disgusting techniques bring shame upon your family. You have no place on these hallowed kiting grounds!
before: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你的恶心手法让你的家人感到羞耻 你没有地方在这些神圣的风筝地上!
after: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这恶心的招数，令家族蒙羞。神圣的风筝赛场，容不下你！

source: Yeah! Get that "cobrastard" OUT of here!
before: 对! 把那个"眼镜怪"从这弄走!
after: 对！把那个“蛇混蛋”赶出去！

source: The event organizers disqualify you. Apparently "don't turn your kite into a drone" is literally Rule #1.
before: 活动组织者取消了你的资格。 显然"不要把你的风筝变成无人机"是规则1的字面意思.
after: 主办方取消了你的资格。原来第一条规矩，真就写着“不许把风筝改成无人机”。

source: It's such a serious thing that the police must escort you out of the tournament in handcuffs... for you have commited a crime against kiting!
before: 这么严重的事情,警察必须用手铐护送你出赛... 你们曾犯罪,以作风为业。
after: 这事严重到，警察得给你戴上手铐，押你出场……因为，你犯下了反风筝罪！

source: You lose your peers' respect (not that they respected you much to begin with), -2 HYPE, and -1 TOURNAMENT.
